title: Azeez Al-Shaair on publicizing Hind Rajab's story: Most of you might not even know who she was

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Azeez Al-Shaair on publicizing Hind Rajab's story: Most of you might not even know who she was
sources.description: The NFL fined Texans linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair $11,941 for writing the name "Hind Rajab" on his eye-black strips during a Week 1 game against the Bills.
